biggest_catch: A $25 account credit has no cash value and is non-transferable; the sponsor must already be an active customer in good standing for 45 days and the credit only lands after the referral's meter is installed or first propane delivery completes.
catches: $25 credit is an account credit only — no cash value, non-transferable.
Sponsor must be an active customer in good standing for at least 45 days before the credit is issued to either party.
Credit is applied only after a meter is installed on the referral's tank, or after the first delivery for non-metered propane accounts.
One referral credit per account activation; self-referrals and existing customers do not qualify.
Customers on Corporate Account pricing are ineligible.
Offer may be modified or canceled at any time without notice.

steps: Go to the South Florida Gas Refer-a-Friend page.
Fill out the referral form with your friend's details.
Your friend activates service with South Florida Gas (meter installed on their tank, or first delivery for non-metered propane).
A $25 account credit is applied to both your account and your friend's account (sponsor must have 45+ days good standing).
